package ui

import "github.com/gsxhq/gsx" // fixture import comment must survive resolution

const unrelatedRecipeDocumentation = "recipe names belong only in canonical class expressions"

component Button(variant string, size string, href string, children gsx.Node, attrs gsx.Attrs) {
	{ if href != "" {
		<a
			class={
				"before gsxui-recipe-button middle sm:hover:[&>svg]:size-4",
				switch variant {
				case "outline":
					"gsxui-recipe-button-variant-outline"
				default:
					"gsxui-recipe-button-variant-default"
				},
				"between",
				switch size { case "icon": "gsxui-recipe-button-size-icon" default: "gsxui-recipe-button-size-default" },
				"after"
			} // Preserve this comment adjacent to the class switches.
			href={href}
			{ attrs... }
			data-gsxui-slot-button
		>
			{ children }
		</a>
	} else {
		<button
			class={
				"before gsxui-recipe-button middle sm:hover:[&>svg]:size-4",
				switch variant {
				case "outline":
					"gsxui-recipe-button-variant-outline"
				default:
					"gsxui-recipe-button-variant-default"
				},
				"between",
				switch size { case "icon": "gsxui-recipe-button-size-icon" default: "gsxui-recipe-button-size-default" },
				"after"
			} // Preserve this comment adjacent to the class switches.
			type="button"
			{ attrs... }
			data-gsxui-slot-button
		>
			{ children }
		</button>
	} }
}
